subject: Mutual Action Plan Launch — Dedicated GPU pool, throughput targets & evaluation plan

Subject: Mutual Action Plan Launch — Dedicated GPU pool, throughput targets & evaluation plan

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to put a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) on your calendar so we can align owners, acceptance criteria for the evaluation, and a close timeline for the Dedicated GPU pool trial. Attached is a first-pass MAP ("MAP-draft-v1.xlsx") and a short throughput/SLA proposal ("throughput-sla-proposal.pdf").

High-level ask: can you confirm who from FintechCo will own procurement and who will be the day-to-day engineering contact for the trial? Our recommendation for a meaningful evaluation is a 2-week trial with the following acceptance criteria:
- Sustained throughput: 1200 requests/minute (avg) across the pool during business hours
- P95 latency target: < 150ms for 2k context typical LLM generation
- Error rate: < 1% (5xx/resets)

Suggested internal owners from our side:
- Laura Bennett — commercial lead / contract & pricing (cc Laura)
- Marissa Cole — trial orchestration & success plan (cc Marissa)
- Ben Carter — infra/throughput lead (cc Ben)

Proposed timeline:
1) This week — confirm stakeholders and sign MAP draft
2) Week 1 — staging trial and baseline throughput testing
3) Week 2 — production-like sustained run, telemetry review, and final acceptance

Please reply with: 1) confirmed FintechCo owners, 2) preferred weekly sync cadence (30m), and 3) any procurement constraints. If you prefer, I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Thursday.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear acceptance criteria. Two quick items:
1) Looping in Procurement: forwarding to procurement@fintechco.com (see below). They will need the SOW + PO process details.
2) Technical / evaluation ask: our infra lead, Priyanka Reddy, will be the day-to-day contact for the trial. Can you include her in the MAP? Her email is priya.reddy@fintechco.com.

We prefer a 30-minute weekly sync on Fridays at 10am PT. The proposed two-week trial sounds reasonable; procurement will likely need a separate week for contract review unless we do an interim trial SOW.

Also, can you confirm whether we can run a canary rollout to 10% of our traffic during the second week? That would help validate fallbacks and routing.

Sara/Priya —

Thanks — I've updated the MAP draft to add Priya as FintechCo's trial owner and added a small procurement checklist in tab 3. Laura, looping you for commercial / SOW coordination.

On canary rollout: yes, we support a 10% canary route on our Smart Routing layer and will instrument automatic fallbacks to a hosted lower-cost model if we observe degradation. We'll include a canary playbook in the trial runbook.

Brief evaluation plan summary (what we'll run during 2-week trial):
- Week 0 (prep): ingest sample prompts, confirm model variant & quantization profile
- Week 1 (staging): load tests to validate throughput target; iterate on batch sizing and kernel selection
- Week 2 (production-like): sustained run with 4-hour sustained windows at target throughput + canary to 10% traffic

Acceptance criteria (restated):
- Sustained throughput: 1200 req/min across the pool for business-hours windows
- P95 latency: <150ms
- Error rate: <1%
- No more than 2 production incidents related to model-serving in the trial window

Next steps I will take:
- Share updated MAP in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-MAP-FINTECHCO
- Send a short SOW / PO checklist for procurement (attached: FintechCo-PO-process.pdf)
- Propose first sync: Friday 2026-10-30 10:00am PT — will that work?

Marissa will lead runbook + weekly reporting; Ben will own GPU pool sizing & monitoring.

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan Launch — Dedicated GPU pool, throughput targets & evaluation plan

Team / Priya —

Quick infra note on sizing and what we'll need to validate during Week 1:
- Initial proposal: 4 x A100 80GB (reserved pool) with autoscale headroom for burst to 6 GPUs. This gives the batch concurrency we expect for 1200 req/min with target latency.
- Batch sizing: start with batch size 8 for gen workloads, iterate if P95 slips.
- KV cache: we'll enable prefix caching for hot prompts — reduces sustained cost by ~20% depending on overlap.
- Monitoring: we'll push a dashboard (per-route latency, tokens/sec, GPU util, OOMs, 5xx rate).

Runbook stub attached: gpu-sizing-proposal.md (text stub). Priya, can you share a sample request distribution (avg tokens / typical prompt length) so I can tune batch targets?

If staging looks good we can finalize the Dedicated capacity reservation and have Laura attach pricing to the SOW.

—Ben
